title: HUTTA: THE PIT BEHIND THE CANTINA
text: Behind the cantina's grease-lit door lies a ring of stone where the crowd roars for blood. Nobody here has a name. A number is chalked on the gate, a wager is scrawled beside it, and the drainage sluice floods the ring when the losers are still breathing.

title: NAL HUTTA: THE HUTT MARSH
text: Greasy rain falls on the marsh the Hutts claim as their seat. Mud swallows the roads, and the oldest clans hold court on raised causeways, where the wealthy never have to step in the water they sell.

title: NAR SHADDAA: THE SMUGGLERS' MOON
text: Stacked thousands of levels high, the Smugglers' Moon never sees the sun. Neon bleeds through the lattice, cargo swings overhead, and every fence on the Promenade keeps a ledger. The Exchange sells anything, and it remembers exactly who owes it.

title: ZX34: THE SILENT SANCTUM
text: A small grey moon hangs beneath a banded giant the locals call the Veil. Carved into a cliff of black basalt is a hall where the Force goes quiet. Step inside and your presence leaves an absence, a hole in the world that others can feel.

title: AMBRIA: THE GLASS WASTES
text: Dunes of black sand roll toward a horizon of ochre dust. Where two rival Sith once fought, the desert fused into mirror-smooth lakes of obsidian. Beneath the storm a tall black obelisk still stands, its cracks glowing like a wound that never closed.

title: RAXUS PRIME: THE HEAP
text: Once a capital of the Kingdom of Cron, this world now drowns in its own waste. Smog hangs over buried towers and rusted hulls, and acid pools steam in the hollows. Scavengers climb the wreckage of a war four thousand years dead.

title: THE REAPER RING
text: A crater of glassy slag marks where the Dark Reaper fell. Hundreds of soldiers died in a single flash, and the heap has tried to forget them ever since. On windless nights the ring is silent, but the dead still march toward its center.

title: KRAYISS II: THE LIBRARY-TEMPLE
text: Sith sorcerers once came here to read in silence, and the temple still keeps their discipline. Buried beneath the crags, its halls answer only the worthy. The obelisk above is the only part left standing, and the spirits within have never forgiven the Jedi who came knocking.

title: THE STYGIAN CALDERA
text: Violet nebula light pours over basalt crags, and sulfur rises on the wind from vents below. In the Sith Worlds at the edge of the caldera, the stars seem to lean closer, as if listening for a voice that stopped speaking long ago.

title: LENICO IV: THE ASH PLAINS
text: Ash drifts over fused-glass pans where a small tribe of thin Ortolans once lived. Aurora curtains ripple across the sky with no source. Pirates avoid the plains, and the few who wander there return quiet, unable to say what they saw.

title: LENICO COLONY BLUE
text: The colony station hangs over the Lenico system like a tooth in an open mouth. Its domes were abandoned in a hurry. The hangars still hold cargo, and the final logs stop mid-sentence. The crews who fled took only what they could carry and never spoke of the ash.

title: TAINTED KYBER CRYSTAL
text: A kyber crystal, dark as spilled ink, that remembers the duel that clouded it. Hold it, and rage rises through your bones like a tide. Every surge feels like strength. The crystal never mentions the cost, and it always, always asks which of the rivals you would have stabbed.

title: LEGACY OF BETRAYAL
text: A data-slate account written by one of two Sith acolytes who turned on their master. Its margins hold notes and underlined phrases, and one word is scratched out: trust. Milian kept it near her bed as a warning. Whoever reads it closely learns exactly where a master bleeds.

title: FRAGMENT OF THE RITUAL OF BINDING
text: A tablet of black stone, half its glyphs gone, describes how a living will is bent into servitude. The rite demands a circle, a heartbeat of focus, and a creature willing to be held. The last line warns that the bound beast will remember the hand that tamed it.

title: MASK OF DESPAIR
text: A pale mask of bone and resin, its eye-holes filled with grey glass. Those who wear it see their own failures walking beside them. Jedi seekers lose the scent of their quarry while it is worn, and the mask never grows heavier, though the wearer's heart does.

title: FOUNDRY DATABANK
text: A Sith-tuned droid core still humming with tactical routines. Its voice is dry and certain. It notes that Jedi rely on patterns, and that patterns can be broken. Its banks hold the war-droid lines of the Great Sith War, the marching orders, and the flaws in every lightsaber form.

title: SITH AMULET
text: A thumb-sized disc of dull black metal, sold on the Promenade with a grin and a warning. Its inscription is worn smooth by a hundred hands, each one paying too much. The amulet is cheap as a lie, and its power is only as strong as the debt its buyer carries.

title: PIT BEAST BONE HILT
text: The grip of Rathatri's first lightsaber, carved from the jaw of the beast he killed in the pit. The bone is still stained brown, and a hairline crack runs along it like a memory the bone refuses to forget. Every wielder who ever held it knew where it came from.

title: OBELISK SHARD
text: A fragment of black glass chipped from the Ambrian obelisk, cold even in the desert heat. Its surface reflects a duel that never happened in this light. Thon once caged the sorcerer's power in a single spot. This shard is proof the cage has been opened, and that someone was holding the key.

title: THE EVOCII'S FALL
text: Some fifteen thousand years before this age, the Hutts drove the Evocii from their world onto a grey moon. The Evocii built the docks and spaceports that still hold the Smugglers' Moon together, then were enslaved for their labor. Their names were lost in the grind.

title: THE FIVE SACRED WORLDS
text: Before the Sith scattered, five worlds were holy to them. Krayiss II was the most isolated, a library-temple of silent study colonized before the fourteenth millennium BBY. When the caldera swallowed it, only the obelisk stayed above ground, a finger raised in warning to anyone who would dig.

title: THE DEATH OF VARA NREEM
text: Forty-nine years before this age, a Jedi named Vara Nreem walked into the sacred library-temple of Krayiss II. The spirits within weighed her and found her unworthy. Her body was never recovered from the glyph halls, and the obelisk still whispers her name to the storm.

title: THE SMOG OF CRON
text: By eleven hundred years before this age, the factories of Raxus Prime had choked the capitals of the Kingdom of Cron. Smog rolled over the towers, the waste swallowed the streets, and the great world became a junkyard that nobody bothered to clean.

title: THE DARK REAPER AT RAXUS
text: In the Great Sith War, the Sith lord Ulic Qel-Droma unleashed the Dark Reaper over Raxus Prime. Hundreds of Republic soldiers died in a single flash, and their dying minds turned the ground into a field of echoes. The scorched crater is still called the Reaper Ring.

title: THE ORTOLANS OF THE ASH PLAINS
text: The tribe on the Ash Plains was thin as bone and deep in the old rites. A Sith Emperor wanted those rites to carry his mind into new bodies. He sent his apprentice Exal Kressh to learn them, and when she had them, he ordered the village slain. She obeyed, then swore to bring him down.

title: THON AND THE CAGED FIRE
text: A Sith sorceress raised an obelisk on Ambria and tried to command the whole planet through its ritual. The power turned on her and killed her. The Jedi Master Thon came after, sealing the influence within one spot and training apprentices in the desert heat until the Great Sith War called him away.

title: THE HUNT OF 990 BBY
text: A Jedi strike team came to Ambria to take the last known Sith Lord. In the glass wastes they met Darovit, a cousin of Darth Zannah, driven mad by her sorcery. Tho'natu cut him down, believing him to be the prize. The wrong man died on the glass that day.

title: GOTO AND THE EXCHANGE
text: When the Exchange ruled the Smugglers' Moon, its boss was a droid that never left its office. Goto spoke through a hologram and collected on debts. Meetra Surik later cut down two of its crime lords, but the lower levels still whisper its name when a deal goes sour.

title: THE GLASS WAR
text: Two fallen Jedi, once allies, turned their war on each other over the obelisk that Thon once caged. It lasted less than a season. Their armies fused the dunes into mirrors with lightning and fire, and both died in the glass. The obelisk remains, and the rival whose name was struck from every record is still said to walk the glass at night.
